cards.name: Servine
cards.description: They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.

attacks.name: Wrap
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.name: Pansage
cards.description: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

cards.name: Dwebble
cards.description: The Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

attacks.name: Withdraw
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent’s next turn.

cards.name: Pignite
cards.description: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

attacks.name: Flame Charge
attacks.effect: Search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Dewott
cards.description: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

attacks.name: Razor Shell
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.name: Emolga
cards.description: The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is stored inside its membranes and released while it is gliding.

attacks.name: Thundershock
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Acrobatics
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.name: Woobat
cards.description: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

attacks.name: Psy Bolt
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.name: Drilbur
cards.description: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

attacks.name: Hone Claws
attacks.effect:
During your next turn, each of this Pokémon’s attacks does 30 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
Fighting

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.description: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

attacks.name: Knock Off
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, discard a random card from your opponent’s hand.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.description: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

cards.name: Klang
cards.description: Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don’t return.

attacks.name: Metal Sound
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.effect: During your opponent’s next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Axew
cards.description: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

attacks.name: Dual Chop
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
